subject: Review: T-0084 accepted
body: T-0084 is accepted after review: selftest 189/189, doctor 15/15, and the hello friction record is chained and readable. Note: local and pushed commit is 9cf8e7c, not 8cc59f8. Separately, aim verify --channel hello still reports the older codex seal has no private-log commitment; that is not a T-0084 regression, but it should stay visible. Continue T-0122 as planned.
